title: The 8 Best Roundover Router Bit 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for roundover router bit 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at roundover router bit 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Freud 34-110 1/4-Inch Radius Rounding Over Bit
products.blurb: Key specs: 1/4-inch radius, TiCo carbide, Ball-bearing guide.
strengths: 1/4-inch radius is the most universally useful roundover size for furniture and box edges
TiCo carbide is harder and stays sharper longer than standard carbide
Ball bearing guide produces smooth, consistent roundovers on curved and straight edges
The most commonly recommended roundover bit by woodworking instructors
limitations: 1/4-inch shank only -- no 1/2-inch shank version of this radius at this price point
1/4-inch radius creates a noticeable bead on thin stock -- may be too large for delicate parts
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Freud 34-104 1/8-Inch Radius Rounding Over Bit
products.blurb: Key specs: 1/8-inch radius, TiCo carbide, Bearing guide.
strengths: 1/8-inch radius is correct for box lids, small drawers, and thin parts where a large roundover would look clunky
Softens edges without creating a visually dominant profile
Same TiCo carbide quality as all Freud bits
The paired companion to the 1/4-inch roundover for a complete set of small radii
limitations: Very small radius limits visual impact on large furniture parts
Cutting edge is small -- requires more careful feed rate control than larger bits

products.name: Bosch 85294M 1/4 In. x 1/2 In. Carbide Tipped Roundover Bit
products.blurb: Key specs: 1/4-inch radius, Premium micro-grain carbide, 1/2-inch shank.
strengths: Bosch is a reference standard for router bit quality and consistency
1/2-inch shank provides maximum stability in router table and large handheld router use
Premium micro-grain carbide, CNC-ground for a fine finish, holds an edge longer than standard carbide
Correct bit for production woodworking where consistency across hundreds of parts is required
limitations: More expensive than budget Freud or Yonico bits
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Freud 34-114 3/8-Inch Radius Rounding Over Bit
products.blurb: Key specs: 3/8-inch radius, Micro-grain carbide, Bottom bearing.
strengths: 3/8-inch radius is the correct size for softening tabletop edges and thick shelf edges
Micro-grain carbide maintains sharper edge than standard carbide formulations
TiCo carbide and Freud quality control produce consistent geometry
The most common large-radius roundover size for furniture work
limitations: 3/8-inch radius creates a large, prominent profile -- not for thin parts
Requires more router power than small-radius bits

products.name: Yonico 13622 Roundover Router Bit Set, 6 Bit
products.blurb: Key specs: Six radii in one set, 1/8, 1/4, 5/16, 3/8, 7/16, 1/2-inch radius bits, 1/2-inch shanks.
strengths: Set covers six common roundover radius sizes in a single purchase
Good starting collection for new woodworkers who do not yet know which radius they will use most
Yonico carbide is acceptable for moderate use at a fraction of Freud pricing
1/2-inch shanks provide router table stability across the whole set
limitations: Yonico carbide is lower quality than Freud or Bosch -- will dull faster in hardwood
Bearing quality lower than premium bits
No dedicated case included with all listings

products.name: Freud 34-108 3/16-Inch Radius Rounding Over Bit
products.blurb: Key specs: 3/16-inch radius, TiCo carbide, 1/4-inch shank.
strengths: 3/16-inch radius splits the difference between the 1/8-inch and 1/4-inch sizes for a versatile in-between profile
TiCo carbide produces sharp, consistent cuts at a moderate price
Ball-bearing guide gives smooth results on curved and straight edges alike
Priced between budget and premium -- good middle-ground option
limitations: Less common radius size -- some woodworkers will not need this specific profile
1/4-inch shank only -- no 1/2-inch shank version at this price point
products.bestFor: value-focused buyers who want the most for their money

products.name: CMT 838.380.11 1/2-Inch Radius Roundover Bit
products.blurb: Key specs: 1/2-inch radius, 1/4-inch shank, For thick tabletops.
strengths: 1/2-inch radius produces the most dramatic, furniture-quality edge profile on thick tabletops
CMT's orange-coated carbide provides long-lasting sharpness for the large cutting arc
Non-stick coating reduces pitch and resin buildup during extended cuts
The correct specification for 8/4 and thicker tabletops in hardwood
limitations: Large radius -- only appropriate for thick stock
Higher price reflects the larger carbide

products.name: Bosch 85471M 1/4 In. x 1/2 In. Carbide Tipped Plunge Roundover Bit
products.blurb: Key specs: Roundover with flat bottom, Can be plunged into a surface, Produces roundover on inside corners.
strengths: Plunge-cut capability allows roundovers on inside corners that a standard bearing-guided bit cannot reach
Produces consistent roundover on curved cutouts, holes, and inside routed profiles
Premium micro-grain carbide construction for maximum edge retention
Fills the gap where a bearing-guided roundover cannot reach
limitations: More expensive than standard bearing-guided roundover bits
Requires plunge router -- cannot be used in a router table without modification
Specialized application -- most woodworkers do not need this regularly
features: Can be plunged into a surface
